name: Fresh Pry Marks
description: Scrape marks on the safe's edge, made with a tool no more than a few days old -- not decade-old rust.

name: Disturbed Basement Dust
description: A single set of fresh footprints crossing a decade of undisturbed dust, leading toward the service stairwell up to Room 207.

name: Probate Attorney's Letter
description: A letter warning that if the original deed surfaces, it names the land a public trust -- voiding Renee's inheritance entirely.

name: Caretaker's Log
description: Tobias's logbook, ending abruptly the same night with the line 'someone's been in Room 207 again.'

name: Torn Appraisal Note
description: A note in Marcus Bell's handwriting estimating the hotel's fixtures at well under what he offered publicly -- he wanted it cheap, not the deed.
